description: Run a Google search through the ScrapeUnblocker API (https://docs.scrapeunblocker.com) and return the results page as JSON: organic results with their real URLs, favicons, sitelinks and star ratings, ads, the AI Overview, People also ask, related searches with their links, the knowledge panel, top stories, videos, local and shopping results.

pages_to_check.description: How many result pages to collect (default 1).

proxy_country.description: Optional ISO country code to search from, e.g. 'US'.

name: google_search
title: Google search results
